verdict.rationale: Governance and stewardship are a fair question for any web framework, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack says whether Angular is run by a foundation or a single company. The one Google mention (angular-comm-14) describes a Google engineer's use of AngularJS internally, not who governs the project, so it is not evidence about governance.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether the framework is governed by a foundation or a single company, so I can assess long-term continuity and lock-in risk
